context.text: I think I'll try making my own luggage tag, maybe with fabric or washi tape. It'll be a fun DIY project. By the way, do you have any suggestions on how to keep my cross-body bag clean and organized? I've been trying to declutter it and only carry the essentials, but I'm not sure what's the best way to organize the compartments.

I think I'll try using small pouches or bags to store small items and assign a home for each item. I've also been meaning to clean my bag more regularly, so I'll make sure to do that too. Speaking of bags, I've been thinking about getting a smaller bag for daily errands and grocery shopping. Do you have any recommendations for a good canvas tote bag or any other type of bag that would be suitable for that purpose?

I've been thinking about incorporating spaced repetition into my daily routine, especially for French vocabulary. Since I've been having daily conversations with my abuela in Spanish, I've noticed that my vocabulary has improved significantly, and I'd like to apply that same approach to French. Do you think spaced repetition can help me learn French grammar rules as well, or is it more effective for vocabulary acquisition?

I've been tracking prices for a while, and they seem to be around the same range. I'm pretty flexible with my travel dates, but I do want to travel during the summer. Do you think Norwegian Air's financial issues would affect their flight operations or service quality?
I've been thinking about using AwardWallet to track my loyalty programs. Do you think it would be able to track my points at The Daily Grind coffee shop?

These all sound great, thanks! I've been on a roll with reading lately, having finished six books in the past three months. I think I'll start with "All the Light We Cannot See" and see how it goes. Do you have any audiobook recommendations that I could listen to on my daily commute?
I'm having some issues with my TV, the picture has been flickering lately and I'm not sure why. Can you help me troubleshoot the problem or find a TV repair service in my area?

That's a wonderful list of gratitude practices to incorporate into the workshop! I especially like the idea of the "Forgiveness Letter of Gratitude" and the "Gratitude Circle". I think these activities can help attendees shift their perspective and focus on the good in the situation. 

Speaking of perspectives, I've been thinking about how my recent experiences at St. Mary's Church on January 10th have influenced my thoughts on forgiveness and compassion. Father John's sermon really resonated with me, and I've been trying to incorporate more forgiveness and gratitude into my daily life. Do you think it would be helpful to share some personal anecdotes or experiences during the workshop to illustrate the power of forgiveness and gratitude?

I've started organizing my emails, and it's actually been really nice to re-read all the congratulatory messages. It's a great way to relive the moment and remember how far I've come. I'm thinking of creating a folder for emails related to my thesis as well, since it was a significant part of my Master's program. Do you think that's a good idea?

I'm going to visit a local antique shop this weekend to see what kind of pieces they have. I've been eyeing a specific type of vase that's been popular in my family for generations, and I'm hoping to find one that matches the description. Do you think I should mention my family's connection to the vase when I'm talking to the dealer, or should I keep that information to myself?
